title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 10.4 Polar Coordinates: Graphs: Test polar equations for symmetry.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 10.4 Polar Coordinates: Graphs: Test polar equations for symmetry.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "10.4 Polar Coordinates: Graphs", prints these objectives: "Test polar equations for symmetry." "Graph polar equations by plotting points.". The section text says: "The planets move through space in elliptical, periodic orbits about the sun, as shown in Figure 1 . They are in constant motion, so fixing an exact position of any planet is valid only for a moment. In other words, we can fix only a planet’s instantaneous position. This is one application of polar coordinates , represented as ( r , θ ) . We interpret r as the distance from the center of the sun and θ as the planet’s angular bearing, or its direction from the center of the sun. In this section…" This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
